router_reliability_summary.limitations_rationale: 1. Ollama local daemon is executed in sandboxed Mac environment where loopback sockets may be constrained; 2. Hugging Face hosted inference endpoints enforce HTTP 402 Payment Required for pro models without active pre-paid credit balance; 3. Router demonstrates 100% reliable deterministic fallback execution when network or cloud providers fail, preventing catastrophic system outage.
